text: Hubert Selby Jr.'s Last Exit to Brooklyn, published in 1964, caused a stir in England, where in November 1967 a jury judged it guilty of being obscene. Its British publisher, Calder and Boyars, appealed and won, and the book was free to appear in a complete and unexpurgated edition.
